title: Design Sensei source registry (catalog/sources.yaml)
description: Canonical registry of every upstream source. Fields that were not verified by inspection must say so explicitly (pending_verification / unknown).

type.description: What kind of thing the URL is.

acquisition_method.description: git_shallow = depth-1 clone; git_sparse = depth-1 sparse clone limited to sparse_paths; reference_only = never downloaded, URL and notes only.

sparse_paths.description: Directories to check out for git_sparse (cone mode; top-level files are always included).

pinned_commit.description: Exact upstream commit the catalog was verified against. null only for reference_only sources or before a first sync.

license.description: SPDX identifier as detected at the pinned commit, or NOASSERTION / LicenseRef-* when custom, missing or unknown.

license_status.description: verified = license text inspected and matches the SPDX id; custom_terms = non-standard license text, human review needed; proprietary_terms = terms restrict redistribution; not_found = no license or terms found; pending_verification = not inspected yet; unknown = inspected but undecidable.

redistribution_status.description: redistributable_with_notice = permissive license, keep notices; license_specific = restrictions need case-by-case handling; reference_only = link and describe only; unresolved = no rights granted; pending_verification = not decided yet.

npm_packages.description: Package names the source itself publishes (verified from its package manifests).

inspection_status.description: inspected_local = cloned and read at the pinned commit; inspected_remote = only remote metadata / HTTP checked; blocked = could not be inspected (reason in notes); pending = not inspected yet.
